effective_architecture.fable_allowed_role: one bounded advisory critique after the pipeline is complete and validated

corrections.mistake: The prototype combined the separate final-release reviewer policy with the recurring Qwen teacher loop.
The corrected schema was tested before Fable had been removed from the recurring teacher list.

glm.charge_note: No response wrapper was received, so a reported charge is unavailable. Remote billing may have occurred.

corrections.known_charge_excludes: Any provider-side charge for the interrupted GLM request.

corrections.mistake: GLM and Kimi were invoked sequentially even though their audits are independent, and an invalid Kimi invocation was allowed to reach the join as a terminal record.
corrective_actions: GLM and Kimi now fan out concurrently and join before Codex.
Invalid invocations now create immutable linked repair attempts.
Codex runs only after both logical teacher chains terminate with valid audits.
Out-of-packet finding identities are preserved as contract warnings instead of discarding an otherwise schema-valid audit.

corrections.mistake: The first parallel implementation retained a 30-minute non-streaming response timeout, allowing both accepted provider requests to wait without an application response for at least 29 minutes.

glm.charge_note: No provider usage wrapper was received. Remote billing may have occurred.

kimi.charge_note: No provider usage wrapper was received. Remote billing may have occurred.

corrective_actions: Each provider attempt now has a four-minute response deadline.
A timeout has zero teacher weight and creates a new linked attempt.
Timeout recovery reroutes away from the first configured provider.
Three timeouts exhaust the chain and block Codex, limiting the worst-case wait to twelve minutes.

corrections.mistake: Kimi was configured at maximum reasoning even though the requested setting was high reasoning with the full output allowance. Its first active stream reached the four-minute ceiling, the direct fallback had no configured key, and the route planner then rotated back to Moonshot instead of blocking on the unavailable independent fallback.

kimi.charge_note: No final usage wrapper was returned for either interrupted Moonshot stream. Provider-side charges may have occurred.

corrective_actions: Kimi reasoning is now explicitly high while the context-safe maximum output allowance remains unchanged.
An unavailable independent fallback now blocks the Kimi chain instead of rotating back to the primary Moonshot route.
The configuration mismatch and all partial streams remain preserved as ineligible evidence.

corrections.mistake: The aggregate evidence hash was computed before the run-complete record and final lifecycle event were written, so the published trace index could not be reproduced from the completed directory.
corrective_actions: Completion state and the final event are now written before the aggregate is computed.
The public-summary copy is excluded to avoid a circular hash.
A separate validator recomputes the completed index.

corrections.mistake: The raw teacher evidence existed in the ignored archive, but the Codex packet projected only a small subset of its metadata. Codex correctly refused to assume that omitted route, response-model, normalized-stream, timing, usage, and cost records existed.
corrective_actions: Codex now receives every complete credential-free teacher attempt record.
Requests, headers, raw SSE, normalized events, assembled responses, and parsed audits now have explicit byte-count and SHA-256 bindings.

corrections.mistake: Codex returned a substantively useful object with one partial pair identity, but the harness had no linked Codex repair chain and terminated the run after preserving the invalid object.
corrective_actions: A malformed or contract-invalid Codex object now has zero decision weight and triggers a bounded linked fresh invocation.
Valid substantive Codex decisions are never retried.

corrections.mistake: The one-shot critique harness passed a JSON Schema draft declaration that Claude Code 2.1.210 could not resolve. The CLI rejected the local schema before sending a model request.
corrective_actions: The unsupported draft declaration was removed.
The harness now rejects draft declarations and external schema references before claiming a future one-shot marker.
This failure is attributed to NULSPEC's harness and is not classified as a Fable refusal.

preservation.linked_execution_repair_scope: One invalid Codex structured adjudication in v9 was preserved and reissued. No valid scientific answer was retried.
